function: Hybrid analog-digital beamforming (precoder design) for a JCAS/DFRC downlink, trading off communications sum rate against radar beampattern error (p. 4, p. 6).
system: BS with 64-antenna ULA, 4 RF chains (hybrid), 4 single-antenna users, 3 radar angles; mmWave; wideband case 28 GHz, 1 GHz, 8 subcarriers (p. 3, p. 10, p. 13).
method: Deep unfolding of modified projected gradient ascent: step sizes learned by unsupervised training on loss R minus weighted beampattern error; I=120 layers, Adam, 1000 channels (p. 6, p. 10).
data_channel: Own extended Saleh-Valenzuela channel, Q=10 paths, gains CN(0,1), angles U(0,360 deg); 1000 training channels, results averaged over 100 test realizations (p. 3, p. 10).
test_conditions: Trained over SNR 0-12 dB, 1000 channels; results averaged over 100 channel realizations at same N=64, K=M=4; wideband case is a separate design; no new scenario (p. 10-13).
baselines: Non-learned only: conventional PGA with fixed step sizes, SCA-ManOpt, fully digital ZF (communications only); no earlier learned method compared (p. 12).
metrics: Communications sum rate R, beampattern deviation tau, beampattern MSE, objective R minus omega tau; number of F and W updates to converge (p. 11-12).
complexity: Counts of multiplications and additions, O(IJ max(NM^2K, N^2K)) overall (Tables I, II, p. 8); about 65% lower complexity and run time than PGA without unfolding (p. 11).
q1_support: p. 10: "To generate the channels in (2), we set Q = 10" with CN(0,1) gains and uniform angles, and p. 3: "We adopt the extended Saleh-Valenzuela model", so the channel is an own simulator. Missing: a 3GPP, QuaDRiGa, DeepMIMO or measured channel.
q2_support: p. 10: "The simulation results are averaged over 100 channel realizations" at "N = 64" and K = M = 4, with training over the SNR range [0, 12] dB; the wideband case (p. 13, N = 32) is a separate design. Missing: a test on another array size, user number, channel model or band.
q3_support: p. 12: "conventional PGA with fixed step sizes", "JCAS-HBF design based on SCA and ManOpt" and "The fully digital ZF beamformer" are all non-learned; the J = 1, 10, 20 curves are variants of the proposed model. Missing: an earlier learned design (the learned works of p. 2, [52]-[55], are not compared).
q4_support: p. 8: "the overall computational load for implementing the proposed deep unfolded PGA algorithm" is O(IJ max(NM^2K, N^2K)) operations, with multiplication and addition counts in Table I; p. 11: "a reduction of approximately 65% in computational complexity and run time".
q5_support: p. 10, footnote 1: "The source code is available at https://github.com/nhanng9115" (full link in openness, read from the page image).
notes: Included as area 5 (ISAC): the learned part is a deep unfolded PGA whose step sizes are trained to design the hybrid precoders that trade rate against beampattern error; deep unfolding with trained parameters counts as learned. No RIS (metasurface antennas appear only in the related work, p. 2). q3 is 0 because no earlier learned method is compared.
